summary: Learn to structure JV terms, decision rights and alliance controls. Review practical contract tools and enrol in this five-day course.
lede: Joint venture training helps commercial, legal and alliance professionals structure and administer shared commercial commitments. Participants practise turning partner commitments into usable contract and governance records by mapping contributions, assigning obligations, designing decision and escalation routes, and tracking performance, changes and exit requirements.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who shape, negotiate or administer shared commercial commitments and need practical contract and governance artefacts.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with commercial contracts, partnership proposals or contract administration is expected. No coding or specialist software installation is required.
